query_text: A minor owns property that needs to be sold on the minor's behalf. Could the father of a minor child sell property on behalf of the minor? What is the procedure for selling a minor's property? What would happen to the consideration paid?

hits.title: Malliya v. Ariyaratne - NLR - 145 of 65 [1962] LKCA 7; (1962) 65 NLR 145 (16 March 1962)
